verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials is a fair question for an AI assistant platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents nothing of the kind: no API keys, token scopes, or per-agent credential issuance. Connectors that link Copilot to OneDrive, Outlook.com and Google services are an adjacent integration feature, not user-issued scoped credentials, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
